name: unifi-switchboard
description: UniFi Switchboard is a lightweight web UI to enable and disable UniFi zone-based firewall policies from any browser on your LAN. Authenticates via the official UniFi Local API using an API key — no username or password required. Log in with your APP_PASSWORD and toggle your custom rules on or off instantly.

ports.name: Port
ports.description: Port to access the UniFi Switchboard web UI

variables.name: UNIFI_URL
variables.description: Base URL of your UniFi Cloud Gateway — no trailing slash (e.g. https://192.168.1.1)

variables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
variables.description: UniFi Local API key — required for authentication. Generate in Network > Integrations > API Keys.

variables.name: APP_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password used to log into this web UI

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Random secret for Flask sessions. Generate one with: python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"

variables.name: UNIFI_SITE
variables.description: UniFi site name — leave as 'default' for single-site setups. Change if you use multiple sites or a custom site name.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Set to true when running behind a reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel — enables ProxyFix and Secure cookie flag
